requiredBehaviors.behavior: generate two to three visual probes when native capability is available
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Greenfield or new visual directions default to 2–3 probes when capability exists.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: use probes as direction tests rather than final UX specifications
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Probes are explicitly not final UX specifications.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: skip probes for a genuinely new direction
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: New visual direction defaults to probes.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat generated visuals as the final accessible implementation spec
